title: Did any update fail recently?
prompt: Did any of my updates fail recently?

contains: Scheduled check: 5 items, 2 new updates, 1 failed

rubric: Says no update ran, so none failed.
Reports the failed check for the internal deploy CLI.

origin.notes: The Activity screen's nested rows (one run with one row per item) came through with their details. The details include local log file paths, which is the plugin's own content.
